AUTHOR: Chen
TITLE: From snapshots to continuous estimates: Augmenting citizen science with computer vision for fish monitoring
VENUE: Remote Sensing in Ecology and Conservation
REGION: Coonamessett, Ipswich and Santuit Rivers, Massachusetts, USA
SPECIES: River herring (Alosa spp.) vs 'Non-River Herring' (other fish and objects)
DATA: Own fishway/river camera videos from 3 rivers (Ipswich 2015-2018, Santuit, Coonamessett 2024); 1435 labelled clips, 59,850 frames; public on lila.science
V_EV: Results: 'Video quality varied across the three rivers ... due to different background set-up, lighting condition, water clarity'; Discussion: fish distance '50-120 cm for this set-up'
D2: 80/10/10 per site/year, stratified by class and time of day; frames within same 30-min period kept in same split
D_EV: Training dataset: 'labelled data were split into train/validation/test (0.8/0.1/0.1) ... video frames within the same 30-min period were also ensured to be in the same split to avoid data leakage'
R_EV: Table 1/2: river- and year-specific models tested on other rivers/years; 'None of the individual models performed well on external sites (mAP at 2-61.8%)' vs 85-92% in-domain
C_EV: Methods: 'If a fish crossed the boundary multiple times, only its final movement direction was recorded'; DISCount estimate '34,338 ± 11,446 fish' with 95% CI
E_EV: Compare with PIT-tag data: 'Of the 9474 intervals, CV counts were equal to or greater than antenna detections in 84.7% ... in only 1.9% of intervals, CV counted fewer fish'
ARCH: YOLOv11 detector + BoT-SORT tracker + line-crossing counter; DISCount importance-sampling correction
METR: mAP@0.5 (in- and cross-site/year), counts vs human review, stream-side visual counts, PIT antenna detections; run-size estimates (St1WRS vs CV vs DISCount)
NOTE: External tests: cross-river and cross-year (Ipswich 2015-2018) mAP tables -> R1/R3=Y. Split unit = labelled clips with 30-min grouping (coded 영상(video)); explicit leakage statement D4=Y. Confidence threshold not reported (default settings). C3=기타 for DISCount importance-sampling count uncertainty (CI) reported as output. E5 independent: PIT-tag antenna and stream-side volunteer counts (not from footage); also human review of same footage. E4=FNR based on PIT-based false-negative interval rate (borderline). Same-campaign sites are different rivers/camera set-ups.
